answer: The funder cannot insulate itself by spreading keys across labels, because the ember funding graph is rebuilt from the zenith history every epoch. Bonds funded from the same source address are linked into one exposure, so 222 aliases paid from one wallet count as a single position when a slash is applied. Since one verdict then reaches every linked key, the operator pays 222 bonds yet holds one position, and the gale report publishes the merged exposure. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
